136.title: Melkhior's Cauldron Hub
136.challenge: The central nexus of the castle where Melkhior's great cauldron bubbles with eldritch energy.
136.solution: Observe the rising spirit bubbles to discern which charm Melkhior demands. Collect the matching item from across the castle and drop it directly into the cauldron ([Shift] to drop) to advance the ritual.
136.warning: Werewolf form cannot safely approach Melkhior; green repel spells guard the chamber at night. Return in Human form by day to deliver charms.
136.form_synergy: Human form is welcomed by the wizard. If night falls while carrying an item, seek shelter until dawn.

79.title: Chamber of Spikes
79.challenge: A deadly hall lined with rows of razor-sharp iron spikes and high pillars.
79.solution: Keep strictly to the raised masonry blocks and stone tables. Line up each jump carefully along the isometric diagonals, utilizing full jump apex clearance.
79.warning: Touching any spike row is instantly lethal. Do not attempt ground-level shortcuts.
79.form_synergy: Werewolf form possesses greater jump arc (+22%), making clearing multiple spike gaps significantly easier.

47.title: The South-West Archway
47.challenge: One of the castle's primary gateways, connecting dungeon chambers with woodland portals.
47.solution: Take stock of your starting surroundings. Standard archways can be walked through freely, but watch for elevated lintels requiring jumping assistance.
47.warning: Bouncing mines and patrol sentinels may wander through neighboring corridors.
47.form_synergy: Both Human and Werewolf forms can traverse this room with ease.

68.title: The Eastern Vestibule
68.challenge: A junction chamber flanked by stone pillars and high archways.
68.solution: Check all four doorway portals. If an archway is elevated 3 meters above the floor, push adjacent wooden tables or stone blocks beneath the lintel to build a step.
68.warning: Watch for falling weights from high ceilings when passing beneath stone lintels.
68.form_synergy: Werewolf form can leap directly into some low-to-mid elevation archways without pushing blocks.

143.title: The Northern Gatehouse
143.challenge: A heavily fortified northern corridor opening into the dense woodland fringe.
143.solution: Navigate past perimeter pillars. Use moveable blocks as mobile stepping stones to reach elevated ledges.
143.warning: Woodland tree doorways connect directly into wild forest rooms where mossy low walls obstruct quick escapes.
143.form_synergy: Werewolf form gains enhanced ground speed across open woodland terrain.

179.title: The Western Portcullis Hall
179.challenge: A narrow fortified corridor guarded by rhythmic iron portcullises.
179.solution: Observe the rise and fall of the portcullis gates. Time your passage so you cross the threshold right as the iron grate reaches its highest apex.
179.warning: Never linger directly beneath a falling portcullis; the descending iron gate will crush anything caught beneath it.
179.form_synergy: Sprint through the gate opening immediately after it begins its upward stroke.

109.title: Gargoyle Bastion
109.challenge: A multi-tiered chamber with stone gargoyles perched high atop stone blocks.
109.solution: Gargoyles are stationary guardians. Path around their direct sightlines and scale the stone blocks on the opposite wall.
109.warning: Physical contact with a gargoyle causes instant death. Maintain safe spacing when jumping from block to block.
109.form_synergy: Jump diagonally past gargoyle perches rather than leaping directly across their positions.

155.title: Oscillating Platforms & Spikes
155.challenge: A treacherous chamber with razor-sharp floor spikes and an elevated archway on the South wall (3.0m elevation).
155.solution: The stone blocks here are autonomous oscillating shuttles (not pushable). Climb onto the static blocks along the side, time your jump onto the moving block as it glides past, ride it across the spike pit, and leap through the elevated South arch.
155.warning: The moving blocks cannot be pushed or stopped. Stepping or falling into the floor spikes is instantly fatal.
155.form_synergy: Werewolf form (+22% jump apex) provides significantly safer clearance when leaping between the shuttles and the elevated South arch.

100.title: The Chest & Trench Archway
100.challenge: A narrow chamber with an elevated South archway (2.25m elevation) and a sliding wooden chest.
100.solution: Push the chest south into the trench before the archway. Stand upon the dais/chest (elevation 0.75m). Reaching the 2.25m high arch requires a 1.50m vertical leap: wait for Night to transform into the Werewolf (+22% jump bonus = 1.65m leap), or drop-climb any carried charm from inventory to build an extra step in Human form.
100.warning: Do not attempt the 1.50m leap as Human Sabreman without a drop-climb step — you will fall short by just a few inches.
100.form_synergy: Werewolf form has the exact jump height needed to clear the 1.50m leap from the chest directly into the South arch.

16.title: The Northern Spiked Precipice
16.challenge: A sheer precipice with high masonry ledges (3.0m elevation) guarded by falling spiked balls.
16.solution: This chamber is primarily designed as a one-way descent when journeying North from Room 32. From the high southern ledge, hop across the masonry platforms while timing past falling spiked balls, then drop down to the ground floor exit. Scaling back up from ground level to the South archway requires carrying charms in your inventory from neighboring rooms and drop-climbing ([Shift]) to build stepping stones.
16.warning: The ground-level floor has no built-in masonry steps to the 2.25m ledges. Do not drop down unless you intend to journey northward.
16.form_synergy: Werewolf form allows wider diagonal leaps across the high ledges to bypass falling spiked spheres.

168.title: The Isolated Pillar Relic
168.challenge: A sacred charm rests high atop the isolated eastern stone pillar (3.0m elevation). The three high pillars are separated by 3.0-meter chasms over floor spikes that exceed standard jump distance.
168.solution: Do not attempt to leap across the yawning chasm between the high pillars — the gap cannot be cleared with a normal jump. Instead, walk along the safe ground floor directly to the base of the eastern pillar. Drop-climb two carried charms from your inventory ([Shift]) at the pillar's foot to build a two-step staircase, then hop up to claim the relic.
168.warning: Stepping off the high western pillar will drop you straight into the iron spike traps below.
168.form_synergy: If 'Jump Boost' is enabled in Settings, Werewolf form can leap directly across the chasm; otherwise, ground-floor drop-climbing is the intended solution.

199.title: The Ghost & Elevated Gate
199.challenge: A chamber with an elevated Southern gate (3.0m elevation) guarded by a wandering spectral phantom.
199.solution: A moveable stone block sits atop the roaming ghost. In Werewolf form, leap onto the moving block as it passes, ride the phantom across the chamber, and jump directly into the 3.0m South doorway (1.50m block elevation + 1.65m Werewolf apex = 3.15m reach). In Human form, carry an inventory charm and drop-climb it onto the moveable block to gain the needed height.
199.warning: Human jump (1.35m) from atop the block reaches 2.85m, falling 15cm short of the 3.0m high archway. Use Werewolf form or an extra drop-climb item.
199.form_synergy: Werewolf form possesses the full vertical apex required to leap from the moving ghost stack straight into the southern arch.
